title: DesignContext
description: The travel/filter input to the design engine: what a design should be ABOUT. Derived deterministically from the user's travel data by TravelProfileAnalyzer. Stage 1 of the pipeline (see design_engine/docs/architecture.md). Never contains rendering or aesthetic decisions.

schemaVersion.description: Bump on any breaking change to this schema.

scope.description: The travel filter this design is built for. Maps onto CountrySetOption.source plus region/trip/random extensions.

countryCodes.description: The resolved ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country set this design draws (lowercase). Order-insensitive; de-duplicated. For 'random' this is a seeded sample of allCountryCodes.

allCountryCodes.description: The user's full lifetime visited set — context for relative rarity/persona even when scope narrows the visible set.

year.description: Required when scope == 'year'. The calendar year the visible set is filtered to.

region.description: Required when scope == 'region'. A continent, sub-region, or custom polygon selection.

id.description: Continent name (kCountryContinent value), subregion id (continent_subregion_map), or custom key.

trip.description: Required when scope == 'trip'. References a TripRecord (single-country visit window).

continents.description: Distinct continents represented by countryCodes (derived from kCountryContinent).

dominantContinent.description: Most-represented continent in the visible set — a layout/palette bias hint.

signatureCountries.description: Rare/standout countries in the set worth featuring (from TravelProfile.signatureCountries).

density.description: Coarse size bucket of the visible set. Mirrors MerchDensityClass; drives template priors via MerchTemplateRanker.

persona.description: Travel persona classification (TravelPersona) — a soft prior over templates/palettes, not a hard constraint.

scopeTitle.description: Human label for the scope (e.g. 'Europe 2024', 'Japan'). Presentation only — the printed title is generated downstream by TitleGen.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale for any locale-sensitive downstream text.

generatedAtEpochMs.description: When this context was analysed. Provenance only; MUST NOT feed the design seed (would break reproducibility).
